1. `httpx.get(url, ...)` is re-exported by [`httpx/__init__.py`](<work>/httpx-rules-official-codex/httpx/__init__.py:2). It calls `request("GET", url, ...)`, which creates and enters a temporary synchronous `Client`, then calls `client.request(...)`. [`httpx/_api.py`](<work>/httpx-rules-official-codex/httpx/_api.py:174)
2. `Client.request()` calls `build_request()` to merge client defaults and construct a `Request`, then passes it to `Client.send()`. [`httpx/_client.py`](<work>/httpx-rules-official-codex/httpx/_client.py:771)
3. `Client.send()` configures timeout and auth, then calls `_send_handling_auth()`. That starts `Auth.sync_auth_flow()` and calls `_send_handling_redirects()`, which runs any request hooks before calling `_send_single_request()`. [`httpx/_client.py`](<work>/httpx-rules-official-codex/httpx/_client.py:879)
4. `_send_single_request()` calls `_transport_for_url()` to select the default or proxy transport, then hands off to `transport.handle_request(request)`. [`httpx/_client.py`](<work>/httpx-rules-official-codex/httpx/_client.py:1001)
5. `HTTPTransport.handle_request()` converts the request to an `httpcore.Request` and calls `self._pool.handle_request(req)`. [`httpx/_transports/default.py`](<work>/httpx-rules-official-codex/httpx/_transports/default.py:230)
